page.content:
Empire wizard who used to be Bren Aldric Ermendrud.

How Caleb Widogast connects

  • Faction: Mighty Nein — Caleb Widogast is the wizard of the Mighty Nein.
  • Character: Liam O'Brien — Liam O'Brien plays Caleb Widogast.

What is Caleb Widogast?

Caleb Widogast is Liam O'Brien's Campaign 2 wizard, a filthy-coat transmuter fleeing the Soltryce Academy and Trent Ikithon while the Mighty Nein become his second family.

Key threads lead to Mighty Nein and Liam O'Brien.
